video.title: Why Two Accounts Can Beat One

elements.content: Same money. Two accounts instead of one. People saved more.
When your savings sit in one pile,
In one study of low-income consumers, splitting money set aside
for a goal into two parts raised savings.
A visible reminder of the goal helped too.
Split its money into two separate parts.
Then keep a picture of the goal where you'll see it.
Try it today: name one goal, and split its savings in two.
